beats.headline: TSM drops 6.2% alongside chip peers
beats.explanation: TSM fell 6.22% on 1.5 times average volume following a 6-K filing the prior day. The decline was broadly shared across connected semiconductor companies, with supplier ASML down 4.62% and customers AMD and INTC sliding 7.49% and 6.53%, respectively.

beats.headline: TSM gains 6.8% in broad semiconductor rally
beats.explanation: TSM rose 6.78% to close at $337.95 on 1.9 times normal trading volume. No company-specific news was provided, and the move was shared across its ecosystem as supplier ASML gained 5.33% while customers INTC and NVDA climbed 7.14% and 5.59%.

beats.headline: TSM falls 3.1% following annual filing
beats.explanation: TSM declined 3.13% to $363.35 on heavy volume of 2.7 times the 30-day average after releasing two 6-K reports and its annual 20-F filing. The move was company-specific, as customer and competitor INTC rose 5.48% and customer AMD gained 7.80%, though supplier ASML dropped 4.79%.

beats.headline: TSM rises 5.3% as key customers advance
beats.explanation: TSM climbed 5.26% to $387.44 on 1.7 times its 30-day average volume with no company-specific filings. The advance aligned with gains among major customers, including AMD rising 6.67% and AVGO up 5.09%, while supplier ASML dipped 1.05%.

beats.headline: TSM adds 5.2% following 6-K filing
beats.explanation: TSM gained 5.17% to close at $402.46 on 2.2 times average volume after filing a 6-K. The upward momentum was shared across the sector, with customer QCOM surging 11.12% and customer and competitor INTC jumping 23.60%.

beats.headline: TSM gains 4.5% after dual 6-K reports
beats.explanation: TSM rose 4.48% to $417.72 on 1.9 times normal volume following two 6-K filings submitted two days earlier. Performance across its network was mixed, with customer AVGO up 5.52% while customer QCOM slid 6.14% and customer and competitor INTC fell 3.62%.

beats.headline: TSM gains 4.1% despite mixed customer moves
beats.explanation: TSM climbed 4.11% to $435.63 on 1.9 times 30-day average volume without any company-specific news. The advance was largely company-specific, as customer NVDA advanced 6.26% but customers AAPL and QCOM dropped 1.84% and 8.78%, respectively.

beats.headline: TSM surges 6.9% in broad semiconductor rally
beats.explanation: TSM rose 6.93% to $462.12 on elevated trading volume of 2.7 times its 30-day average. The gain was part of an industry-wide rise, with supplier ASML moving up 3.31% and customers INTC and QCOM advancing 10.64% and 6.17%, respectively.

beats.headline: TSM advances 5.3% with supplier ASML
beats.explanation: TSM gained 5.26% to close at $455.10 on 1.5 times average volume with no new company disclosures. The move was shared with supplier ASML, which rose 4.93%, and customer AMD, which gained 3.43%, while customer AAPL was down 0.72%.

beats.headline: TSM slides 7.0% alongside peers and suppliers
beats.explanation: TSM fell 6.98% to $444.23 on 1.9 times normal volume in the absence of fresh company announcements. The drop mirrored wide losses across its network, including supplier ASML sliding 7.36% and customers INTC and AMD dropping 9.03% and 6.89%.

beats.headline: TSM rebounds 5.5% with semiconductor peers
beats.explanation: TSM gained 5.55% to finish at $424.61 on 1.9 times average volume without company filings. Connected firms rallied alongside it, including customer and competitor INTC rising 8.64%, customer AMD up 8.11%, and supplier ASML climbing 3.59%.

beats.headline: TSM gains 7.6% alongside AMD and Intel
beats.explanation: TSM jumped 7.64% to $403.31 on 1.8 times 30-day average volume with no company-specific updates provided. The upward surge was shared across major supply chain partners, as supplier ASML rose 6.50% while customers AMD and INTC jumped 13.00% and 11.30%.
